capabilities: Translate whole notes or selections into bilingual English-Chinese paragraphs
Choose among Gemini, MiniMax, DeepSeek, and Microsoft Translator engines
Preserve Markdown syntax, LaTeX, and code blocks while skipping frontmatter and wiki links
Chunk long articles to avoid API timeouts with progress notifications
Trigger translation via right-click menu or command palette
extras: Community Store listing marked 'Coming soon!'; manual installation via release files described. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, so reading English articles means leaving the app or losing Markdown formatting to external translators.

relations.evidence: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite: Ultra-fast, high-quality, and free-tier support.
MiniMax M2.7: State-of-the-art Chinese LLM for natural expression.
DeepSeek: Cost-effective and highly precise English-Chinese translation.
Microsoft Translator: Solid fallback for high-volume free translation.

requires.name: Gemini, DeepSeek, MiniMax, or Microsoft Translator key

summary: Translation plugin that converts English notes into paragraph-by-paragraph English-Chinese bilingual format using LLM and translator APIs.
